title: Renew a vehicle registration as the carer or guardian of the registered operator
summary: This page explains how to renew a vehicle registration if you are acting as the carer or guardian for the registered operator.
intro: If you're wanting to renew a vehicle registration as the carer or guardian of the registered operator, you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: the billing number (available on your renewal notice or digital Certificate of Registration)
a pensioner concession card in the name of the registered operator
proof of carer or guardian status (court order, Power of Attorney or Statutory Declaration)
compulsory third party (CTP) insurance policy (green slip)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your application.
